g.text: Clinical tenant rows carry clinic_id · composite foreign keys + PostgreSQL RLS enforce scope · platform reads use a separate audited identity
Encrypted: notes · patient identifiers · clinic API keys · comments · transcripts · audio · snapshots
Immutable evidence: versions · audit · provenance · assessments · publication receipts · archive checksums
